title: Economy
description: Economy state used by the simulation's economy/save/ultimate engines (README SS19-22). The round-level loadout/bank snapshot in round.schema.json is the only part CONFIRMED by a real source (VCT Reference). Per-player loadout detail and ultimate points below are FUTURE for real data (extractable from 2D-replay buy panels per vctstats ReplayPageParser) and are POPULATED for synthetic world states.

teamEconomy.description: One team's economy at a point in time. Credits are VALORANT credits (integer).

bank.description: Team's spare credits (sum across players) in credits.

loadoutValue.description: Total value of weapons+armor currently held, in credits.

lossBonusTier.description: Consecutive-loss bonus tier (0..4). FUTURE/derived; affects next-round income (README SS19).

buyType.description: Classified team buy decision (README SS19.3). DERIVED/INFERRED.

playerLoadout.description: One player's purchasable state. FUTURE for real data (buy panel) / POPULATED for synthetic.

weaponId.description: Primary weapon id (valorant-api weapon uuid or lowercase name).

abilityCharges.description: Remaining ability charges keyed by ability slot (c/q/e/x). Units: charge count (integer).

ultimatePoints.description: Ultimate points accrued. Units: ult points (integer).

ultimateCost.description: Ultimate points required for this agent's ult on the match's patch.
